verdict.rationale: Martin is an AI personal assistant that documents automations such as custom multi-step shortcuts, briefings and email triage, so versioning and rolling them back is a fair question for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows versioning, review/diff, change history, or rollback for those automations. The ability to create and edit shortcuts or to-dos is an adjacent capability and does not count as version control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
